project_type: Next.js 15 App Router PWA (Heula) — intermittent fasting, fully offline, no backend, mobile-first iOS styling
build_system: npm + Next.js 15.5.4 (next build generates the Serwist service worker). Quirk: the service worker is disabled in `next dev`; offline/install behavior is only verifiable via `npm run build` then `npm start`.
test_framework: Vitest 3.2.4, environment node, include pattern src/**/*.test.ts, @ alias -> ./src (vitest.config.ts). Pure-logic unit tests only; DOM/IndexedDB flows are checked manually per README smoke checklist.
verification_instructions: After code changes: run `npx tsc --noEmit` for type checking (strict, no any), `npx vitest run` for the full suite (baseline 155 tests across 7 files must stay green and grow), and `npm run build` for the production build. The no-emoji scan (src/lib/__tests__/no-emoji.test.ts) scans ALL of src + README and FAILS on any emoji in any new file or string. Run `npm run lint` (eslint) if touching many files.
snapshot_or_generated_files: next build generates .next and the Serwist service worker; these are not hand-edited and not committed source. null hand-maintained snapshots.
environment_constraints: Local worktree on branch main with pre-existing uncommitted changes (an in-progress ios-styling task: modified src/app/layout.tsx, src/components/layout/BottomTabBar.tsx, new src/components/layout/Chrome.tsx). Do NOT revert or disturb those files. Each feature commits only the files it touches, by name — never `git add -A`. Never push.
contribution_requirements: ZERO EMOJI anywhere in src + README (enforced by vitest scan). ALL icons go through the single choke-point src/components/ui/Icon.tsx which imports ONLY from react-icons/io5 and maps by the IconKey union in src/types/index.ts asserted `satisfies Record<IconKey, IconType>`; to add an icon, add the key to IconKey AND the mapping with a verified io5 name — never import react-icons elsewhere, never use lucide. ALL user-facing copy lives in the typed `copy` object (and GOAL_LABELS) in src/lib/copy.ts, Indonesian casual Gojek voice, no emoji. Pure domain logic goes in framework-free src/lib (no React imports); UI in src/features and src/components. No `any`.
key_patterns: Pure lib modules (recommendation.ts, methods.ts, stats.ts) are React-free and import types from @/types + copy from @/lib/copy. recommendMethod(answers) is pure/deterministic: R1 heavy-exercise early guard returns 14:10 + mandatory warning for ANY goal, then switch(goal) resolves R2-R16 via buildWeightLoss/Metabolic/Focus/Maintain/General, exerciseState(answers) classifies none|light|moderate, canOfferAggressive(answers) is the SOLE gatekeeper letting 20:4/omad appear ONLY in alternatives and ONLY for weight_loss + none/light. Onboarding steps are presentational; OnboardingFlow.tsx holds local draft state and a motion horizontal spring slide, Stepper shows TOTAL_STEPS dots. Store is Zustand 5 persisted to localStorage key heula-store with a partialize whitelist (onboarded, profiling, chosenMethod, customFastingHours, dailyGoalHours, theme, reminders, activeFast) and an onRehydrateStorage hydrated flag; transient hydrated is NEVER persisted. UI primitives: Button (min-h-12, variants, motion whileTap), Card (rounded-card border bg-surface shadow-card). Tailwind v4 CSS-first tokens in src/app/globals.css: brand/brand-fg/brand-soft (emerald), bg/surface/surface-2/border/content/content-muted (light :root + .dark overrides), danger, radius-card/control/pill; dark via @custom-variant dark; safe-* @utility.

directory_structure: src/app (Next App Router routes + globals.css), src/components/ui (shared primitives: Button, Card, Icon, Stepper, EmptyState, Spinner), src/components/layout (Chrome, AppShell, BottomTabBar — DO NOT TOUCH), src/features/onboarding (flow + steps), src/features/stats (StatsOverview, WeeklyBarChart), src/lib (framework-free domain logic + __tests__), src/store (Zustand store + types), src/db (Dexie), src/types (shared domain types).
